# Shavi Homes

Shavi Homes is a top-rated general contractor based in Calgary, AB. We specialize in legal basement construction, secondary suite legalization, permit assistance, basement suite conversions, and backyard suite construction. We also provide full-scale commercial construction services including medical clinics, pharmacies, offices, restaurants, daycares, and wellness spas. We handle all Calgary building permits and zoning bylaws, ensuring a 100% inspection pass rate.

## Services
- Legal Basement Construction
- Secondary Suite Legalization
- Secondary Suite Permit Assistance
- Basement Suite Conversion
- Backyard Suite Construction
- Commercial Construction (Clinics, Pharmacies, Offices, Retail, Spas)
